address: Rei En Jaume 5, Castelló de la Plana, 12001, Spain
bio: In this centrally located restaurant, with its contemporary ambience, you'll find an interesting international approach, with nods to the countries where the chef trained (his native Italy, France, Switzerland and Spain) before settling, for love, in this city. They offer à la carte service (we particularly liked the prawns in different textures) and balanced menus, a lunch menu that varies according to the number of starters and a more creative tasting menu that must be booked in advance....
